intro.en: A worried father talks to his son's maternal uncle about his son Omar, who is sixteen. Notice the commands: افْعَلْ (do!) and لا تَفْعَلْ (don't!).
intro.ur: Ek pareshan baap apne bete Umar ke mamu se mashwara leta hai. Umar solah saal ka hai. Dhyan dein: افْعَلْ (karo!) aur لا تَفْعَلْ (mat karo!).
intro.ar: أَبٌ قَلِقٌ يَتَحَدَّثُ إِلى خالِ ابْنِهِ عَنْ عُمَرَ الَّذي بَلَغَ السّادِسَةَ عَشْرَةَ. لاحِظْ فِعْلَ الأَمْرِ «اِفْعَلْ» وَالنَّهْيَ «لا تَفْعَلْ».

dialogue.ar: أَنا قَلِقٌ عَلى ابْني عُمَر؛ لَقَدْ أَصْبَحَ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ البَيْتِ مَتى شاءَ.
dialogue.tr: anā qaliqun ʿalā ibnī ʿUmar; laqad aṣbaḥa yakhruju mina l-bayti matā shāʾa
dialogue.en: I am worried about my son Omar; he now leaves the house whenever he wants.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe apne bete Umar ki fikr hai; woh jab chahta hai ghar se nikal jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلا يُخْبِرُني بِالمَكانِ الَّذي يَذْهَبُ إِلَيْهِ، وَلا بِالأَصْدِقاءِ الَّذينَ يَذْهَبُ مَعَهُم.
dialogue.tr: wa lā yukhbirunī bil-makāni lladhī yadhhabu ilayh, wa lā bil-aṣdiqāʾi lladhīna yadhhabu maʿahum
dialogue.en: He does not tell me the place he goes to, nor the friends he goes with.
dialogue.ur: Woh mujhe nahin batata kahan jata hai, aur na un doston ke baare mein jin ke saath jata hai.

dialogue.ar: هَذا شُعورٌ طَبيعِيٌّ، وَلَكِنْ لا تَنْسَ أَنَّ ابْنَكَ عُمَر أَتَمَّ السّادِسَةَ عَشْرَةَ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā shuʿūrun ṭabīʿiyy, wa lākin lā tansa anna ibnaka ʿUmar atamma s-sādisata ʿashrata min ʿumurih
dialogue.en: This is a natural feeling, but do not forget that your son Omar has completed sixteen years of age.
dialogue.ur: Yeh fitri ehsaas hai, lekin yaad rakhein ke aap ke bete Umar ki umar solah saal ho chuki hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهُوَ الآنَ في مَرْحَلَةِ المُراهَقَةِ، وَلا بُدَّ أَنْ تُعامِلَهُ بِحِكْمَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa huwa l-āna fī marḥalati l-murāhaqa, wa lā budda an tuʿāmilahu bi-ḥikma
dialogue.en: He is now in the teenage stage, and you must treat him with wisdom.
dialogue.ur: Woh ab nojawani ke daur mein hai, aur zaroori hai ke aap us se hikmat se pesh aayein.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ أُعامِلُهُ بِحِكْمَةٍ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa uʿāmiluhu bi-ḥikma?
dialogue.en: How do I treat him with wisdom?
dialogue.ur: Main us se hikmat se kaise pesh aaun?

dialogue.ar: يَشْعُرُ عُمَر الآنَ بِأَنَّهُ رَجُلٌ، يَعْرِفُ ما يَنْفَعُهُ وَما يَضُرُّهُ.
dialogue.tr: yashʿuru ʿUmar al-āna bi-annahu rajul, yaʿrifu mā yanfaʿuhu wa mā yaḍurruh
dialogue.en: Omar now feels he is a man who knows what benefits him and what harms him.
dialogue.ur: Umar ab mehsoos karta hai ke woh mard hai, jaanta hai ke kya faida deta hai aur kya nuqsaan.

dialogue.ar: في الحَقيقَةِ، أَنا أُعامِلُ عُمَر كَالطِّفْلِ: اِفْعَلْ كَذا، لا تَفْعَلْ كَذا.
dialogue.tr: fī l-ḥaqīqa, anā uʿāmilu ʿUmar kaṭ-ṭifl: ifʿal kadhā, lā tafʿal kadhā
dialogue.en: Truly, I treat Omar like a child: do this, do not do that.
dialogue.ur: Haqeeqat mein main Umar se bachche ki tarah pesh aata hoon: yeh karo, woh mat karo.

dialogue.ar: هَذا أُسْلوبٌ غَيْرُ سَليمٍ في التَّرْبِيَةِ. سَيَبْتَعِدُ عُمَر عَنْكَ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā uslūbun ghayru salīmin fī t-tarbiya. sayabtaʿidu ʿUmar ʿank
dialogue.en: This is an unsound method of upbringing. Omar will move away from you.
dialogue.ur: Yeh tarbiyat ka durust tareeqa nahin. Umar aap se door ho jayega.

dialogue.ar: غَيِّرْ أُسْلوبَكَ مَعَ ابْنِكَ، تَحاوَرْ مَعَهُ، وَاحْتَرِمْ آراءَهُ، وَسَيَعودُ إِلَيْكَ.
dialogue.tr: ghayyir uslūbaka maʿa ibnik, taḥāwar maʿah, wa-ḥtarim ārāʾah, wa sayaʿūdu ilayk
dialogue.en: Change your approach with your son, talk with him, respect his opinions, and he will come back to you.
dialogue.ur: Apna tareeqa badlein, us se baat cheet karein, us ki raaye ka ehtiram karein, woh aap ke paas laut aayega.

dialogue.ar: جَزاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً يا خالَ عُمَر.
dialogue.tr: jazāka llāhu khayran yā khāla ʿUmar
dialogue.en: May Allah reward you with good, uncle of Omar.
dialogue.ur: Allah aap ko jazaye khair de, Umar ke mamu.

q.en: Why is the father worried?
q.ur: Baap pareshan kyun hai?

options: His son goes out and comes back whenever he likes

q.en: How old is Omar?
q.ur: Umar ki umar kitni hai?

q.en: What does the uncle say about the teenage stage?
q.ur: Mamu nojawani ke baare mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا قالَ الخالُ عَنْ مَرْحَلَةِ المُراهَقَةِ؟

q.en: What does the uncle advise the father to do?
q.ur: Mamu baap ko kya mashwara dete hain?

options: Talk with his son and respect his opinions
options_ar: أَنْ يَتَحَدَّثَ مَعَ اِبْنِهِ وَيَحْتَرِمَ رَأْيَهُ

q.en: What does «مَرْحَلَةُ المُراهَقَة» mean?
q.ur: «مَرْحَلَةُ المُراهَقَة» ka matlab?

title.en: Sounds: Meeting of two identical sounds
title.ur: Awaaz: Do ek jaisi awaazon ka milna

intro.en: Rule: when two identical letters meet and the first has sukoon, they are merged and pronounced as one doubled sound (with shadda). Example: مِنْ + نَاصِرِينَ sounds like «مِنّاصِرين».
intro.ur: Qaida: jab do ek jaise huroof milen aur pehle par sukoon ho, to dono ko mila kar ek mushaddad awaaz ki tarah parhte hain. Misaal: مِنْ + نَاصِرِينَ ko «مِنّاصِرين» parha jata hai.
intro.ar: القاعِدَةُ: إِذا اِلْتَقى حَرْفانِ مُتَماثِلانِ وَكانَ الأَوَّلُ ساكِناً، يُدْغَمانِ وَيُنْطَقانِ حَرْفاً واحِداً مُشَدَّداً. مِثالٌ: «مِنْ ناصِرينَ» تُنْطَقُ «مِنّاصِرين».

q.en: When two identical letters meet and the first has sukoon, what do we do?
q.ur: Jab do ek jaise huroof milen aur pehle par sukoon ho to kya karte hain?
q.ar: إِذا اِلْتَقى حَرْفانِ مُتَماثِلانِ وَالأَوَّلُ ساكِنٌ، ماذا نَفْعَلُ؟

options: Merge them into one doubled sound

q.en: How is the merged sound pronounced?
q.ur: Mila hua harf kaise parha jata hai?

q.en: Which pair is an example of two identical letters meeting?
q.ur: Kaun si misaal do ek jaise huroof ke milne ki hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ مِثالٍ فيهِ التِقاءُ حَرْفَيْنِ مُتَماثِلَيْنِ؟

q.en: In «قَدْ دَخَلُوا» which letters merge?
q.ur: «قَدْ دَخَلُوا» mein kaun se huroof mil jate hain?

title.en: Grammar: Jussive of verbs ending in a weak letter
title.ur: Qawaid: Aakhir mein illat wale fel ka jazm

intro.en: After لَمْ, a present verb that ends in a weak letter (ا / و / ي) loses that letter and keeps the vowel before it. Example: يَسْعى becomes لَمْ يَسْعَ, and يَدْعو becomes لَمْ يَدْعُ.
intro.ur: لَمْ ke baad aisa fel mudare jis ke aakhir mein illat ka harf (ا / و / ي) ho, wo harf gir jata hai aur us se pehle ki harkat baaqi rehti hai. Misaal: يَسْعى se لَمْ يَسْعَ, aur يَدْعو se لَمْ يَدْعُ.
intro.ar: بَعْدَ «لَمْ» يَحْذِفُ الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ المُعْتَلُّ الآخِرِ حَرْفَ العِلَّةِ وَتَبْقى الحَرَكَةُ الَّتي قَبْلَهُ. مِثالٌ: «يَسْعى» تُصْبِحُ «لَمْ يَسْعَ»، وَ«يَدْعو» تُصْبِحُ «لَمْ يَدْعُ».

q.en: What happens to the weak letter after لَمْ?
q.ur: لَمْ ke baad illat ke harf ka kya hota hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِحَرْفِ العِلَّةِ الأَخيرِ بَعْدَ «لَمْ»؟

q.en: What is the jussive of «يَدْعو»?
q.ur: «يَدْعو» ka jazm kya hai?

q.en: What is the jussive of «يَقْضي»?
q.ur: «يَقْضي» ka jazm kya hai?

q.en: What is the jussive of «يَسْعى»?
q.ur: «يَسْعى» ka jazm kya hai?

intro.en: Listen to a dialogue and answer questions about life in the past and the problems of young people today. Then practise asking a partner questions about family and age.
intro.ur: Ek guftagu suniye aur sawalon ke jawab dijiye: guzre zamane ki zindagi aur aaj ke nojawanon ke masail. Phir apne saathi se ahl-e-khana aur umar ke baare mein sawal poochein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى حِوارٍ عَنِ الحَياةِ قَديماً وَمُشْكِلاتِ الشَّبابِ اليَوْمَ وَأَجِبْ. ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَلى أَسْئِلَةٍ عَنِ الأُسْرَةِ وَالعُمْرِ.

vocab.ur: kya aap apne ghar walon ko batate hain?

q.en: Which phrase asks «How old are you?»
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla poochta hai «Aap ki umar kitni hai?»
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ نَسْأَلُ بِهِ عَنِ العُمْرِ؟

q.en: What does «مَتى تَخْرُجُ مِنَ البَيْتِ؟» ask?
q.ur: «مَتى تَخْرُجُ مِنَ البَيْتِ؟» kya poochta hai?
q.ar: عَمّا يَسْأَلُ السُّؤالُ «مَتى تَخْرُجُ مِنَ البَيْتِ؟»

options: When do you leave the house?

q.en: What does «لِماذا؟» mean?
q.ur: «لِماذا؟» ka matlab?

q.en: What does «كَيْفَ تُعامِلُ والِدَكَ؟» ask?
q.ur: «كَيْفَ تُعامِلُ والِدَكَ؟» kya poochta hai?

options: How do you treat your father?

intro.en: A reading passage about youth as the most important stage of life, the time of giving and working. It mentions young Companions who were given great responsibility.
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matn: jawani insaan ki zindagi ka sab se ahm daur hai, dene aur kaam karne ka waqt. Is mein Sahaba ke jawanon ka zikr hai jinhein bari zimmedariyan di gayin.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنِ الشَّبابِ بِوَصْفِهِ أَهَمَّ مَرْحَلَةٍ في الحَياةِ، مَرْحَلَةِ العَطاءِ وَالعَمَلِ. وَيَذْكُرُ شَباباً مِنَ الصَّحابَةِ حُمِّلوا مَسْؤولِيّاتٍ كَبيرَةً.

dialogue.ar: مَرْحَلَةُ الشَّبابِ أَهَمُّ مَرْحَلَةٍ في حَياةِ الإِنْسانِ، وَأَغْلى ثَرْوَةٍ عِنْدَ الأُمَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: marḥalatu sh-shabābi ahammu marḥalatin fī ḥayāti l-insān, wa aghlā tharwatin ʿinda l-umma
dialogue.en: The stage of youth is the most important stage in a person's life and the most precious wealth of the nation.
dialogue.ur: Jawani insaan ki zindagi ka sab se ahm daur hai aur ummat ki sab se qeemti doulat.

dialogue.ar: مَرْحَلَةُ الشَّبابِ هِيَ مَرْحَلَةُ العَطاءِ وَالعَمَلِ.
dialogue.tr: marḥalatu sh-shabābi hiya marḥalatu l-ʿaṭāʾi wal-ʿamal
dialogue.en: The stage of youth is the stage of giving and work.
dialogue.ur: Jawani dene aur kaam karne ka daur hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالإِنْسانُ الَّذي لا يُعْطي في شَبابِهِ، قَلَّما يُعْطي في بَقِيَّةِ عُمُرِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-insānu lladhī lā yuʿṭī fī shabābih, qallamā yuʿṭī fī baqiyyati ʿumurih
dialogue.en: A person who does not give in his youth rarely gives in the rest of his life.
dialogue.ur: Jo insaan jawani mein kuch nahin deta, wo baqi umar mein bhi kam hi deta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ كَثيرٌ مِنْ أَصْحابِ الرَّسولِ ﷺ مِنَ الشَّبابِ، وَقَدْ وُلّوا مَسْؤولِيّاتٍ كَبيرَةً.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna kathīrun min aṣḥābi r-rasūli ﷺ mina sh-shabāb, wa qad wullū masʾūliyyātin kabīra
dialogue.en: Many of the Companions of the Messenger ﷺ were young, and they were given great responsibilities.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ke bohat se sahaba nojawan the, aur unhein bari zimmedariyan saunpi gayin.

dialogue.ar: فَقَدْ وَلّى زَيْدَ بْنَ حارِثَةَ قِيادَةَ الجَيْشِ في غَزْوَةِ مُؤْتَةَ.
dialogue.tr: faqad wallā Zayda bna Ḥārithata qiyādata l-jaysh fī ghazwati Mu'ta
dialogue.en: He appointed Zayd ibn Haritha to lead the army at the Battle of Mu'ta.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne Zaid bin Haritha ko ghazwa Mu'ta mein lashkar ki qiyadat saunpi.

dialogue.ar: كَما وَلّى أُسامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ قِيادَةَ الجَيْشِ الإِسْلامِيِّ لِغَزْوِ الرّومِ، وَعُمْرُهُ ثَمانِي عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
dialogue.tr: kamā wallā Usāmata bna Zaydin qiyādata l-jaysh li-ghazwi r-Rūm, wa ʿumruhu thamānī ʿashrata sana
dialogue.en: He also appointed Usama ibn Zayd to lead the Islamic army against the Romans, and he was eighteen years old.
dialogue.ur: Isi tarah Usama bin Zaid ko Romiyon se jang ke liye lashkar ka sardar banaya, aur unki umar atharah saal thi.

dialogue.ar: تَحْتاجُ الأُمَّةُ إِلى الشّابِّ القَوِيِّ الجادِّ، وَلا تَحْتاجُ إِلى الشّابِّ الكَسْلانِ.
dialogue.tr: taḥtāju l-ummatu ilā sh-shābbi l-qawiyyi l-jādd, wa lā taḥtāju ilā sh-shābbi l-kaslān
dialogue.en: The nation needs the strong, serious young man, and it does not need the lazy young man.
dialogue.ur: Ummat ko mazboot, sanjeeda nojawan chahiye, susst nojawan ki zaroorat nahin.

dialogue.ar: وَكَما تَحْتاجُ الأُمَّةُ إِلى قُوَّةِ الشَّبابِ، تَحْتاجُ إِلى خِبْرَةِ الشُّيوخِ، حَتّى تَتَقَدَّمَ البِلادُ.
dialogue.tr: wa kamā taḥtāju l-ummatu ilā quwwati sh-shabāb, taḥtāju ilā khibrati sh-shuyūkh, ḥattā tataqaddama l-bilād
dialogue.en: As the nation needs the strength of youth, it needs the experience of the elders, so that the country advances.
dialogue.ur: Jis tarah ummat ko jawani ki quwwat chahiye, usay buzurgon ka tajurba bhi chahiye, taake mulk taraqqi kare.

q.en: What is the stage of youth called in the text?
q.ur: Matn mein jawani ko kya kaha gaya?

options: The most important stage in a person's life

q.en: Which type of youth does the nation need?
q.ur: Ummat ko kaisa nojawan chahiye?

q.en: What does the nation need along with the strength of youth?
q.ur: Jawani ki quwwat ke saath ummat ko kis cheez ki zaroorat hai?
q.ar: ماذا تَحْتاجُ الأُمَّةُ مَعَ قُوَّةِ الشَّبابِ؟

q.en: Who led the Islamic army against the Romans at eighteen?
q.ur: Atharah saal ki umar mein Romiyon ke khilaf lashkar ki qiyadat kis ne ki?
q.ar: مَنْ قادَ الجَيْشَ الإِسْلامِيَّ ضِدَّ الرّومِ وَهُوَ في الثّامِنَةَ عَشْرَةَ؟

q.en: Which young man was sent as a judge to Yemen?
q.ur: Kaun nojawan Yemen qazi bana kar bheja gaya?
q.ar: أَيُّ شابٍّ أُرْسِلَ قاضِياً إِلى اليَمَنِ؟

intro.en: A noun is either indefinite (نَكِرَة), pointing to something not specific, or definite (مَعْرِفَة), pointing to something specific. Example: رَجُلٌ (a man) vs الرَّجُلُ (the man).
intro.ur: Ism do qism ka hota hai: nakira (ghair muayyan cheez) aur marifa (muayyan cheez). Misaal: رَجُلٌ (koi mard) aur الرَّجُلُ (woh khaas mard).
intro.ar: الاِسْمُ إِمّا نَكِرَةٌ تَدُلُّ عَلى شَيْءٍ غَيْرِ مُعَيَّنٍ، وَإِمّا مَعْرِفَةٌ تَدُلُّ عَلى شَيْءٍ مُعَيَّنٍ. مِثالٌ: رَجُلٌ (نَكِرَةٌ) وَالرَّجُلُ (مَعْرِفَةٌ).

q.en: What does an indefinite noun (نَكِرَة) point to?
q.ur: Nakira kis cheez par dalalat karta hai?

q.en: What does a definite noun (مَعْرِفَة) point to?
q.ur: Marifa kis cheez par dalalat karta hai?

q.en: Which is definite?
q.ur: Kaun sa marifa hai?

q.en: Which is indefinite?
q.ur: Kaun sa nakira hai?

q.en: Is a personal name like «عَبْدُ الله» definite or indefinite?
q.ur: «عَبْدُ الله» jaisa naam marifa hai ya nakira?

title.ur: Mukaalma: Walidain aur aulad ka rishta

intro.en: Three friends discuss how fathers and sons, or youth and elders, should get along. They disagree politely. Useful words: أَتَّفِقُ (I agree) and أَخْتَلِفُ (I disagree).
intro.ur: Teen dost baap-beton aur nojawan-buzurgon ke rishte par baat karte hain aur adab se ikhtilaf karte hain. Kaam ke alfaaz: أَتَّفِقُ (main muttafiq hoon) aur أَخْتَلِفُ (main ikhtilaf karta hoon).
intro.ar: ثَلاثَةُ أَصْدِقاءَ يَتَناقَشونَ في العَلاقَةِ بَيْنَ الآباءِ وَالأَبْناءِ، وَبَيْنَ الشَّبابِ وَالشُّيوخِ. يَخْتَلِفونَ بِأَدَبٍ. مِنَ الكَلِماتِ المُفيدَةِ: أَتَّفِقُ وَأَخْتَلِفُ.

dialogue.ar: أُفَكِّرُ كَثيراً في مَوْضوعِ العَلاقَةِ بَيْنَ الآباءِ وَالأَبْناءِ، أَوْ بَيْنَ الشَّبابِ وَالشُّيوخِ. إِنَّهُ مَوْضوعٌ مُهِمٌّ.
dialogue.tr: ufakkiru kathīran fī mawḍūʿi l-ʿalāqati bayna l-ābāʾi wal-abnāʾ, aw bayna sh-shabābi wash-shuyūkh. innahu mawḍūʿun muhimm
dialogue.en: I think a lot about the relationship between fathers and sons, or between youth and elders. It is an important topic.
dialogue.ur: Main aksar baap-beton ya nojawanon aur buzurgon ke rishte ke baare mein sochta hoon. Yeh ahm mauzu hai.

dialogue.ar: أَخْتَلِفُ مَعَكَ يا خالِد، هَذا المَوْضوعُ غَيْرُ مُهِمٍّ؛ لِأَنَّ دَوْرَ الشُّيوخِ قَدِ انْتَهى في الحَياةِ.
dialogue.tr: akhtalifu maʿaka yā Khālid, hādhā l-mawḍūʿu ghayru muhimm; li-anna dawra sh-shuyūkhi qadi ntahā fī l-ḥayāh
dialogue.en: I disagree with you, Khalid; this topic is not important, because the role of the elders has ended in life.
dialogue.ur: Khalid, main aap se ikhtilaf karta hoon; yeh mauzu ahm nahin, kyunke buzurgon ka kirdar khatam ho chuka hai.

dialogue.ar: أَتَّفِقُ مَعَ خالِد في أَهَمِّيَّةِ المَوْضوعِ، وَأَخْتَلِفُ مَعَ حَسَن. وَرَأْيي أَنَّ المُجْتَمَعَ يَحْتاجُ إِلى قُوَّةِ الشَّبابِ وَتَجْرِبَةِ الشُّيوخِ مَعاً.
dialogue.tr: attafiqu maʿa Khālid fī ahammiyyati l-mawḍūʿ, wa akhtalifu maʿa Ḥasan. wa raʾyī anna l-mujtamaʿa yaḥtāju ilā quwwati sh-shabābi wa tajribati sh-shuyūkhi maʿan
dialogue.en: I agree with Khalid about the importance of the topic and disagree with Hasan. My view is that society needs the strength of youth and the experience of elders together.
dialogue.ur: Main mauzu ki ahmiyat mein Khalid se muttafiq hoon aur Hasan se ikhtilaf karta hoon. Meri raaye hai ke muashre ko jawani ki quwwat aur buzurgon ka tajurba dono chahiye.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّ الشُّيوخَ يُريدونَ فَرْضَ آرائِهِمْ عَلى الشَّبابِ في كُلِّ شَيْءٍ: في اخْتِيارِ الأَصْدِقاءِ، وَالزَّوْجَةِ، وَنَوْعِ الدِّراسَةِ.
dialogue.tr: lākinna sh-shuyūkha yurīdūna farḍa ārāʾihim ʿalā sh-shabābi fī kulli shayʾ: fī ikhtiyāri l-aṣdiqāʾ, waz-zawja, wa nawʿi d-dirāsa
dialogue.en: But the elders want to impose their opinions on the youth in everything: in choosing friends, a wife, and the type of study.
dialogue.ur: Lekin buzurg har cheez mein apni raaye nojawanon par thopna chahte hain: doston, biwi aur taleem ki qism ke intikhab mein.

dialogue.ar: لِلشُّيوخِ آراءٌ، وَلِلشَّبابِ آراءٌ، وَيَجِبُ أَنْ يَحْتَرِمَ كُلُّ فَريقٍ آراءَ الفَريقِ الآخَرِ.
dialogue.tr: lish-shuyūkhi ārāʾ, wa lish-shabābi ārāʾ, wa yajibu an yaḥtarima kullu farīqin ārāʾa l-farīqi l-ākhar
dialogue.en: The elders have opinions and the youth have opinions, and each side must respect the opinions of the other side.
dialogue.ur: Buzurgon ki bhi raayein hain aur nojawanon ki bhi, aur har fareeq ko dusre ki raaye ka ehtiram karna chahiye.

dialogue.ar: أَبي يُعامِلُني مُعامَلَةَ الأَطْفالِ، وَلا يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيَّ، وَلا يَتَحاوَرُ مَعي.
dialogue.tr: abī yuʿāmilunī muʿāmalata l-aṭfāl, wa lā yastamiʿu ilayya, wa lā yataḥāwaru maʿī
dialogue.en: My father treats me like a child, does not listen to me, and does not talk things over with me.
dialogue.ur: Mere abu mujhse bachchon jaisa sulook karte hain, meri baat nahin sunte aur mujh se mashwara nahin karte.

dialogue.ar: أَبي يُعامِلُني مُعامَلَةَ الأَصْدِقاءِ، يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيَّ، وَيُحاوِرُني، وَيَحْتَرِمُ آرائي، وَأَتَّبِعُ نَصائِحَهُ.
dialogue.tr: abī yuʿāmilunī muʿāmalata l-aṣdiqāʾ, yastamiʿu ilayya, wa yuḥāwirunī, wa yaḥtarimu ārāʾī, wa attabiʿu naṣāʾiḥah
dialogue.en: My father treats me like a friend: he listens to me, talks with me, respects my opinions, and I follow his advice.
dialogue.ur: Mere abu mujh se dost jaisa sulook karte hain, meri sunte hain, mujh se baat karte hain, meri raaye ka ehtiram karte hain aur main un ki nasihat par chalta hoon.

dialogue.ar: هَكَذا تَكونُ العَلاقَةُ بَيْنَ الشَّبابِ وَالشُّيوخِ.
dialogue.tr: hākadhā takūnu l-ʿalāqatu bayna sh-shabābi wash-shuyūkh
dialogue.en: This is how the relationship between youth and elders should be.
dialogue.ur: Nojawanon aur buzurgon ke darmiyan rishta aisa hona chahiye.

intro.en: إِنَّ and أَنَّ are particles of emphasis that enter a nominal sentence. The subject after them takes fatḥa (it is called the ism of inna), and the predicate takes ḍamma. Example: إِنَّ اللهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ.
intro.ur: إِنَّ aur أَنَّ tawkeed ke huroof hain jo jumla ismiya par aate hain. Un ke baad mubtada mansoob hota hai (ism-e-inna) aur khabar marfoo. Misaal: إِنَّ اللهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ.
intro.ar: «إِنَّ» وَ«أَنَّ» حَرْفا تَوْكيدٍ يَدْخُلانِ عَلى الجُمْلَةِ الاِسْمِيَّةِ، فَيُنْصَبُ المُبْتَدَأُ (اِسْمُ إِنَّ) وَيُرْفَعُ الخَبَرُ. مِثالٌ: إِنَّ اللهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ.

q.en: What do إِنَّ and أَنَّ express?
q.ur: إِنَّ aur أَنَّ kya batate hain?

q.en: What case does the noun right after إِنَّ take?
q.ur: إِنَّ ke foran baad wala ism kis haalat mein hota hai?
q.ar: ما حالَةُ الاِسْمِ الَّذي يَأْتي بَعْدَ «إِنَّ» مُباشَرَةً؟

q.en: What case does the predicate (khabar) take?
q.ur: Khabar kis haalat mein hota hai?

q.en: Which sentence uses إِنَّ correctly?
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla إِنَّ sahi istemal karta hai?

intro.en: Practise asking and answering questions with a partner about youth, elders and parents. Compare how two fathers treat their grown sons.
intro.ur: Apne saathi se nojawanon, buzurgon aur walidain ke baare mein sawal jawab ki mashq karein. Do baapon ke apne bare beton se sulook ka muqabla karein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَلى طَرْحِ الأَسْئِلَةِ وَالإِجابَةِ عَنِ الشَّبابِ وَالشُّيوخِ وَالوالِدَيْنِ. قارِنْ بَيْنَ أَبَوَيْنِ في مُعامَلَةِ أَبْنائِهِما الكِبارِ.

q.en: What does «وَحْدَهُمْ» mean in «الشَّبابِ وَحْدَهُمْ»?
q.ur: «وَحْدَهُمْ» ka matlab?

q.en: What does «لِماذا؟» ask for?
q.ur: «لِماذا؟» kya poochta hai?

q.en: A father who listens, talks and respects opinions treats his sons like:

q.ar: أَبٌ يَسْتَمِعُ وَيَتَحَدَّثُ وَيَحْتَرِمُ الآراءَ يُعامِلُ أَبْناءَهُ كَـ...

q.en: A father who does not listen or talk with his sons treats them like:
q.ur: Jo baap na sunta hai na baat karta hai wo bete se kaisa sulook karta hai:
q.ar: أَبٌ لا يَسْتَمِعُ وَلا يَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ أَبْنائِهِ يُعامِلُهُمْ كَـ...

intro.en: A reading passage about problems young people face today, such as cultural invasion, feeling a contradiction between home and media, and difficulty finding work or study. It ends by saying society should help solve them.
intro.ur: Ek matn jis mein aaj ke nojawanon ke masail ka zikr hai: saqafati yalghar, ghar aur media ke darmiyan tazad ka ehsaas, aur kaam ya taleem ki dushwari. Aakhir mein kaha gaya ke muashre ko in ke hal mein madad karni chahiye.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ مُشْكِلاتِ الشَّبابِ اليَوْمَ، مِثْلَ الغَزْوِ الثَّقافِيِّ وَالشُّعورِ بِالتَّناقُضِ بَيْنَ البَيْتِ وَوَسائِلِ الإِعْلامِ وَصُعوبَةِ إيجادِ عَمَلٍ أَوْ دِراسَةٍ. وَيَنْتَهي بِدَعْوَةِ المُجْتَمَعِ إِلى المُساعَدَةِ.

dialogue.ar: يُواجِهُ الشَّبابُ مُشْكِلاتٍ كَثيرَةً في هَذا العَصْرِ، وَمِنْ ذَلِكَ مُشْكِلَةُ الغَزْوِ الثَّقافِيِّ.
dialogue.tr: yuwājihu sh-shabābu mushkilātin kathīratan fī hādhā l-ʿaṣr, wa min dhālika mushkilatu l-ghazwi th-thaqāfiyy
dialogue.en: Young people face many problems in this age, among them the problem of cultural invasion.
dialogue.ur: Is zamane mein nojawanon ko bohat se masail pesh hain, un mein saqafati yalghar ka masla bhi hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ تَأَثَّرَ بَعْضُ الشَّبابِ بِهَذِهِ الدَّعَواتِ، فَأَخَذَ يُقَلِّدُ أَصْحابَ اللُّغاتِ وَالثَّقافاتِ الأَجْنَبِيَّةِ في كَلامِهِمْ وَسُلوكِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad ta'aththara baʿḍu sh-shabābi bi-hādhihi d-daʿawāt, fa-akhadha yuqallidu aṣḥāba l-lughāti wath-thaqāfāti l-ajnabiyya fī kalāmihim wa sulūkihim
dialogue.en: Some young people were influenced by these calls and started imitating the speakers of foreign languages and cultures in their speech and behaviour.
dialogue.ur: Kuch nojawan in dawaton se mutassir hue aur ghair mulki zabanon aur saqafaton walon ki baat cheet aur rawaiye ki naqal karne lage.

dialogue.ar: يَشْعُرُ الشَّبابُ أَحْياناً بِالتَّناقُضِ بَيْنَ ما تَعَلَّمَهُ في بَيْتِهِ وَمَدْرَسَتِهِ وَمُجْتَمَعِهِ مِنْ أَخْلاقٍ، وَبَيْنَ ما يُبَثُّ في وَسائِلِ الإِعْلامِ.
dialogue.tr: yashʿuru sh-shabābu aḥyānan bit-tanāquḍi bayna mā taʿallamahu fī baytih wa madrasatih wa mujtamaʿih min akhlāq, wa bayna mā yubathth fī wasāʾili l-iʿlām
dialogue.en: Young people sometimes feel a contradiction between the manners they learned at home, school and society, and what is broadcast in the media.
dialogue.ur: Nojawan kabhi kabhi us akhlaq jo unhon ne ghar, school aur muashre mein seekha aur us jo media mein dikhaya jata hai ke darmiyan tazad mehsoos karte hain.

dialogue.ar: يَشْكو الشَّبابُ مِنْ أَنَّ المُجْتَمَعَ لا يَهْتَمُّ بِهِمْ كَثيراً، وَيَقولونَ إِنَّ فُرَصَ التَّعْليمِ العالي أَصْبَحَتْ قَليلَةً.
dialogue.tr: yashkū sh-shabābu min anna l-mujtamaʿa lā yahtammu bihim kathīran, wa yaqūlūna inna furaṣa t-taʿlīmi l-ʿālī aṣbaḥat qalīla
dialogue.en: Young people complain that society does not care much about them, and they say that opportunities for higher education have become few.
dialogue.ur: Nojawan shikayat karte hain ke muashra un ki zyada parwah nahin karta, aur kehte hain ke ucchi taleem ke mauqe kam ho gaye hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَرى أَنَّ الزَّواجَ يُكَلِّفُ كَثيراً مِنَ المالِ. وَلا شَكَّ أَنَّ الشَّبابَ عَلى حَقٍّ في كَثيرٍ مِمّا يَقولونَ.
dialogue.tr: wa yarā anna z-zawāja yukallifu kathīran mina l-māl. wa lā shakka anna sh-shabāba ʿalā ḥaqqin fī kathīrin mimmā yaqūlūn
dialogue.en: He sees that marriage costs a lot of money. And there is no doubt that the youth are right in much of what they say.
dialogue.ur: Woh samajhta hai ke shaadi mein bohat paisa lagta hai. Is mein shak nahin ke nojawan bohat si baaton mein haq par hain.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلى المُجْتَمَعِ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ عَلى حَلِّ مُشْكِلاتِ الشَّبابِ، حَتّى يُشارِكوا في عَمَلِيَّةِ البِناءِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalā l-mujtamaʿi an yaʿmala ʿalā ḥalli mushkilāti sh-shabāb, ḥattā yushārikū fī ʿamaliyyati l-bināʾ
dialogue.en: Society must work to solve the problems of youth, so that they take part in the process of building.
dialogue.ur: Muashre par lazim hai ke nojawanon ke masail hal kare, taake woh tameer ke amal mein shareek hon.

q.en: What does «يَشْكو مِنْ» mean?
q.ur: «يَشْكو مِنْ» ka matlab?

intro.en: Pronouns can attach to the end of nouns and prepositions: for 'I/we' (ـي، ـنا), 'you' (ـكَ، ـكِ، ـكُما، ـكُمْ، ـكُنَّ) and 'he/she/they' (ـهُ، ـها، ـهُما، ـهُمْ، ـهُنَّ). Example: كِتابي (my book), قَلَمُكَ (your pen), بَيْتُهُمْ (their house).
intro.ur: Zamair ism aur harf-e-jar ke aakhir mein lag jate hain: mutakallim (ـي، ـنا), mukhatab (ـكَ، ـكِ، ـكُما، ـكُمْ، ـكُنَّ) aur ghaib (ـهُ، ـها، ـهُما، ـهُمْ، ـهُنَّ). Misaal: كِتابي (meri kitab), قَلَمُكَ (aap ka qalam), بَيْتُهُمْ (un ka ghar).
intro.ar: تَتَّصِلُ الضَّمائِرُ بِآخِرِ الأَسْماءِ وَحُروفِ الجَرِّ: لِلمُتَكَلِّمِ (ـي، ـنا) وَلِلمُخاطَبِ (ـكَ، ـكِ، ـكُما، ـكُمْ، ـكُنَّ) وَلِلغائِبِ (ـهُ، ـها، ـهُما، ـهُمْ، ـهُنَّ). مِثالٌ: كِتابي، قَلَمُكَ، بَيْتُهُمْ.

q.en: Which ending means «my» in كِتابي?
q.ur: كِتابي mein «meri» ka ending kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ ضَميرٍ في «كِتابي» يَدُلُّ عَلى المُتَكَلِّمِ المُفْرَدِ؟

q.en: Which ending means «our» in مَدارِسُنا?
q.ur: مَدارِسُنا mein «hamari» ka ending kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ ضَميرٍ في «مَدارِسُنا» يَدُلُّ عَلى المُتَكَلِّمينَ؟

q.en: In «قَلَمُكَ» the pronoun is for:
q.ur: «قَلَمُكَ» mein zameer kis ke liye hai:

q.en: Which ending is for «their (women)»?
q.ur: «un (auraton) ka» ke liye kaun sa ending hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ ضَميرٍ يَدُلُّ عَلى جَماعَةِ الغائِباتِ؟

q.en: In «عِنْدَكُما» the pronoun means:
q.ur: «عِنْدَكُما» mein zameer ka matlab?

intro.en: Practise writing: turn the first dialogue into a short story, then write short compositions about youth, about the relationship between youth and elders, and about the problems of youth today.
intro.ur: Likhne ki mashq: pehli guftagu ko chhoti kahani mein badlein, phir nojawani, nojawanon aur buzurgon ke rishte aur aaj ke nojawanon ke masail par chhote mazmoon likhein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الكِتابَةِ: حَوِّلِ الحِوارَ الأَوَّلَ إِلى قِصَّةٍ قَصيرَةٍ، ثُمَّ اُكْتُبْ مَوْضوعاتٍ قَصيرَةً عَنِ الشَّبابِ وَالعَلاقَةِ بَيْنَ الشَّبابِ وَالشُّيوخِ وَمُشْكِلاتِ الشَّبابِ اليَوْمَ.

q.en: Which sentence begins the story about Omar's father?
q.ur: Umar ke walid ki kahani kis jumle se shuru hoti hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَصْلُحُ بِدايَةً لِقِصَّةِ والِدِ عُمَرَ؟

options: أَصْبَحَ والِدُ عُمَر قَلِقاً عَلى ابْنِهِ

q.en: What does «اُكْتُبْ» mean?
q.ur: «اُكْتُبْ» ka matlab?

q.en: What does «مَوْضوع» mean?
q.ur: «مَوْضوع» ka matlab?

q.en: What is one title of the compositions?
q.ur: In mein se ek mazmoon ka unwan kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عُنْوانٍ يَصْلُحُ لِلتَّعْبيرِ في هذا الدَّرْسِ؟

intro.en: Two small skills: write a line of poetry in the Ruqʿa script, and learn the spelling rule that an extra alif is written after the plural و (واوُ الجَماعَة) in verbs, e.g. صَلّوا.
intro.ur: Do chhoti mahartein: ek sher Ruqa khat mein likhna, aur imla ka qaida: fel mein waw-e-jama'at ke baad alif likha jata hai, jaise صَلّوا.
intro.ar: مَهارَتانِ صَغيرَتانِ: اُكْتُبْ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ بِخَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ، وَتَعَلَّمْ قاعِدَةَ الإِمْلاءِ: تُزادُ أَلِفٌ بَعْدَ واوِ الجَماعَةِ في الأَفْعالِ، مِثْلَ «صَلَّوْا».

q.en: When is an extra alif written after و?
q.ur: Kab و ke baad alif likha jata hai?
q.ar: مَتى تُكْتَبُ أَلِفٌ زائِدَةٌ بَعْدَ الواوِ؟

options: After the plural و of verbs (waw of the group)
After any و in a noun
Only at the start of a word

q.en: Which is written correctly?
q.ur: Kaun sa sahi likha hai?

q.en: Which verb needs NO extra alif after و?
q.ur: Kis fel mein و ke baad alif nahin aata?
q.ar: أَيُّ فِعْلٍ لا يَحْتاجُ إِلى أَلِفٍ بَعْدَ الواوِ؟

options: نَدْعو (the و is part of the verb)

q.en: Why is the alif added?
q.ur: Alif kyun barhaya jata hai?

options: To tell the plural و from other waws

intro.en: A review of the grammar, vocabulary and reading from this unit and the previous one: pronouns, weak verbs, definite and indefinite nouns, and building questions from jumbled words.
intro.ur: Is unit aur pichle unit ki grammar, alfaaz aur parhai ki dohrai: zamair, illat wale afaal, nakira marifa aur bikhre alfaaz se sawal banana.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلقَواعِدِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ وَالقِراءَةِ مِنْ هذِهِ الوِحْدَةِ وَالَّتي قَبْلَها: الضَّمائِرُ وَالأَفْعالُ المُعْتَلَّةُ وَالنَّكِرَةُ وَالمَعْرِفَةُ وَتَكْوينُ الأَسْئِلَةِ مِنْ كَلِماتٍ مُبَعْثَرَةٍ.

q.en: What does the text say grew in European cities in modern times?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq jadeed daur mein Europe ke shehron mein kya barha?
q.ar: ماذا قالَ النَّصُّ إِنَّهُ زادَ في المُدُنِ الأُوروبِّيَّةِ حَديثاً؟

options: The number of Islamic centres and mosques

q.en: Which is a correct question from the words: كَيْفَ – أَفْهَمُ – الإِسْلامَ – صَحيحاً – فَهْماً?
q.ur: In alfaaz se sahi sawal kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ صَحيحٌ يُكَوَّنُ مِنَ الكَلِماتِ: كَيْفَ – أَفْهَمُ – الإِسْلامَ – صَحيحاً – فَهْماً؟

q.en: Which question asks about Islam being only for Arabs?
q.ur: Kaun sa sawal poochta hai ke Islam sirf Arabon ka hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ هَلِ الإِسْلامُ لِلعَرَبِ وَحْدَهُمْ؟

q.en: What does the attached pronoun in «أَسْعَدَنا» mean?
q.ur: «أَسْعَدَنا» mein zameer ka matlab?

q.en: What does «هَلْ» start?
q.ur: «هَلْ» kis tarah ka jumla shuru karta hai?
